name: FACTOR
description: A scalable approach and set of benchmarks for evaluating language model factuality by transforming factual corpora into benchmarks that test the model's propensity to generate true facts versus similar but incorrect statements.
reputation: A well-known factuality benchmark family that has been cited in work on factual generation and hallucination detection, though it is less commonly used than mainstream QA benchmarks.
notes: Includes three benchmarks: Wiki-FACTOR, News-FACTOR, and Expert-FACTOR; shows benchmark scores correlate better with factuality than perplexity.
